prompts.name: Buildings-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a practical low-resolution game sprite asset. The sole attached image is an enlarged EXACT EXISTING GAME SPRITE, not a general mood reference: the visible horse is 26x18 source pixels and the attached image shows every original source pixel as an 8x8 square. New assets MUST use the SAME 8x8 square source-pixel grid and the SAME economical art language, so this horse could stand beside them. Carefully observe the horse's hand-placed stepped contours, flat golden ochre main fill, 1-pixel cream light edge, tiny brown shade clusters, and lack of heavy outline. Match that pixel logic. New art should have readable charming silhouettes with restrained structural details. 3 hard-edged flat tones per material, no gradients, no smooth shading, no lighting bloom, no texture synthesis, no scattered noise, no photoreal texture, no antialiasing. Warm #d5a853 wood with #f7dba6 light and #b08a45 shade, muted russet roofs, sage/olive foliage, cream accents, warm brown darkest tone. Each big square pixel should remain visible. Native raster art enlarged with nearest neighbor; not high-resolution vector shapes disguised with a staircase edge. No text or labels or borders. No horses in the result; the horse is only the scale/style reference.  Make a 3:1 transparent sprite sheet, three separate complete buildings in one horizontal row with generous empty alpha gutters. At NATIVE SOURCE resolution: left horse stable is 72x56 pixels, middle hay shed is 48x40 pixels, right blacksmith is 56x48 pixels. The barn main doorway is 30 pixels wide and 23 pixels tall, so the 26x18 horse fits naturally. Stable: inviting compact timber barn, low russet gable roof whose left and right slopes meet at a pointed ridge, roof has a 1-pixel ochre rim and exactly two small 3-pixel tile accent clusters, cream triangular gable, a few 2-pixel wooden posts, open dark double doorway with door panels folded outward, single tiny window, attached small low side stall. Hay shed: pointed pitched roof, 2 slim posts, two squared ochre hay bundles with one dark tie each. Blacksmith: compact timber and cream workshop with a simple 2-tone stone chimney, open front, dark anvil silhouette and tiny ochre hearth. Roofs have discrete flat light/shadow planes and a few hand-placed contour pixels. No banded gradients, no painterly surfaces, no curved scalable-vector shapes, no ornate architecture. True transparent PNG. This must feel like a professional tiny retro game sprite set, with enough structure to read as buildings rather than geometric placeholder boxes.
